claims.claim_text: Agent Metrics implementation is complete
claims.verification_method: Read all metrics/*.py source files; count public functions; check MetricsCollector, MetricsSession, MetricsConfig, poster, payload_builder all exist and have implementations
claims.actual_finding: src/plugin_examples/metrics/ contains: session.py (EXTERNAL_POST_COMMANDS=frozenset({'run'}), MetricsSession class), config.py (MetricsConfig with enabled=False default, dry_run=True default), models.py (LLMCallRecord, MetricsCollector), poster.py (HTTP POST with dry_run guard), payload_builder.py (payload construction). All 5 core modules exist with implementations. 117 unit tests across 9 test files.

claims.claim_text: Agent Metrics production posting is blocked by design (not a failure state)
claims.verification_method: Read poster.py for blocking condition; check dry_run default in config.py; read AGENT_METRICS_PRODUCTION_ENABLED logic
claims.actual_finding: config.py: enabled=False, dry_run=True by default. poster.py: guards check dry_run flag before POST. metrics.yml: enabled: false, dry_run: true at config level. AGENT_METRICS_PRODUCTION_ENABLED env var is the production gate. Post ledger has 2 entries (one test, one production pilot-cells-20260508-112957 with http_status=200) — production posting HAS been verified once. Current state: blocked by default, not by inability.

claims.claim_text: TC14 production enablement is not started or gated by env var
claims.verification_method: Read session.py for EXTERNAL_POST_COMMANDS; read poster.py for env var gate; check AGENT_METRICS_PRODUCTION_ENABLED usage
claims.actual_finding: session.py: EXTERNAL_POST_COMMANDS = frozenset({'run'}) — only 'run' command can trigger external POST. poster.py: checks AGENT_METRICS_PRODUCTION_ENABLED env var. Post ledger: 2 production entries (one is pilot-cells-20260508-112957 with http_status=200 and dry_run=false). TC14 production posting HAS been successfully executed once — it is not 'not started'. It is enabled-by-config-change (requires AGENT_METRICS_PRODUCTION_ENABLED=true and --metrics-post flag).
claims.note: Claim is partially true: enablement IS gated by env var (correct). But 'not started' is incorrect — one production post was successfully verified (pilot-cells run).

claims.claim_text: Words denominator is 9 (9 runnable scenarios)

claims.actual_finding: words.yml allowed_types: [Converter, Watermarker, Splitter, Replacer] — 4 types. families/words/example-lifecycle-records.json: total_planned=25, generation_passed=4, excluded_by_allowed_types=21. claims.claim_text: Words denominator is 25 (all WORKFLOW_ROOT types in Aspose.Words.LowCode namespace)
claims.verification_method: Read words-source-of-truth-proof.json for public_type_count; read words.yml for allowed_types
claims.actual_finding: words-source-of-truth-proof.json: namespace Aspose.Words.LowCode has public_type_count=25, public_method_count=230. families/words/example-lifecycle-records.json: total_planned=25. However, words.yml restricts to 4 allowed_types — 21 of the 25 types are excluded by policy. Both 4 and 25 are valid denominators for different questions: 4 = allowed coverage, 25 = total namespace coverage.
claims.note: 25 is correct for total namespace types. However, 25 is not the operational denominator for current pipeline scope (which uses 4 allowed_types). Coverage = 4/4 = 100% of allowed types, OR 4/25 = 16% of total namespace.
